title: Algebraic techniques
summary: Expanding binomial products, perfect squares, difference of two squares, factorising (including trinomials), and algebraic fractions.

cards.title: Expanding binomial products
cards.rule: Multiply every term in the first bracket by every term in the second.

cards.title: Perfect squares and DOTS
cards.tip: \((x + 3)^2 \ne x^2 + 9\): don't forget the middle term.

cards.title: Factorising expressions
cards.rule: Take out the highest common factor (HCF).
cards.note: Check by expanding: you should get back to the start.

cards.title: Factorising DOTS
cards.rule: Difference of two squares: \(a^2 - b^2 = (a - b)(a + b)\)

cards.title: Factorising by grouping
cards.rule: Group into pairs, take out a factor from each, then the common bracket.

cards.title: Monic quadratic trinomials
cards.rule: \(x^2 + bx + c\): find two numbers that multiply to \(c\) and add to \(b\).

cards.title: Trinomials \(ax^2 + bx + c\)
cards.rule: Find two numbers that multiply to \(a \times c\) and add to \(b\). Split the middle term, then group.

cards.title: Algebraic fractions: × and ÷
cards.rule: Factorise, cancel common factors, then multiply. To divide, flip the second fraction.

cards.title: Algebraic fractions: + and −
cards.rule: Use a common denominator, then add or subtract the numerators.

cards.title: Further simplification
cards.rule: Factorise first, then cancel whole factors.
cards.tip: cancel factors, never single terms: \(\dfrac{x + 3}{3} \ne x\)

cards.title: Equations with algebraic fractions
cards.rule: Multiply both sides by the lowest common denominator to clear the fractions.
